== Notes ==

* You can target any [[NPC]], including [[ally|allies]], [[foe]]s, or [[interactive object]]s.
** You will shadow step directly away from your target.
** When self-targeting, you will step to a random location within [[earshot]] distance.
** If you self-target while adjacent to a [[charmable animal]], it will be poisoned, but it will not turn hostile.

* It can also be used to jump on or off bridges, shorter hills, or walls.
{{anomaly|This spell does not have an [[aftercast delay]].}}
